content: शम् {%ind.%} A particle meaning welfare, happiness, prosperity, health, and generally used to express a blessing or pious wish, (with <ab>dat.</ab> or <ab>gen.</ab>); शं देवदत्ताय or देवदत्तस्य (often used in modern letters as an auspicious conclusion; इति शम्).

शम् I. €4 <ab>P.</ab> (शाम्यति, शान्त) .²1 To be calm, quiet or tranquil, be appeased or pacified (as a person); शाम्येत् प्रत्यपकारेण नोपकारेण दुर्जनः <ls>Ku. 2. 40</ls>; काकुत्स्थमुद्दिश्य समत्सरोऽपि शशाम तेन क्षितिपाललोकः <ls>R. 7. 3</ls>; शान्तो लवः <ls>U. 6. 7</ls>; <ls>Bh. 2. 75</ls>. .²2 To cease, stop, come to an end; चिन्ता शशाम सकलाऽपि सरोरुहाणाम् <ls>Bv. 3. 7</ls>; न जातु कामः कामानामुपभोगेन शाम्यति <ls>Ms. 2. 94</ls> ‘is not satisfied’. .²3 To be quelled, be extinguished or quenched; शशाम वृष्टयापि विना दवाग्निः <ls>R. 2. 14</ls>; <ls>U. 5. 7</ls>. .²4 To desist, leave off (speaking <ab>&c.</ab>). .²5 To put an end to, destroy, kill (also €9 <ab>P.</ab> in this sense). --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} (शमयति-ते, but शामयतिते in the sense of ‘seeing’, see शम् II). .²1 To appease, allay, calm, tranquillize, pacify, soothe; कः शीतलैः शमयिता वचनैस्तवाधिम् <ls>Bv. 3. 1</ls>; संरम्भं शमयामास <ls>R. 15. 85</ls>, <ls n="R.">17. 55</ls>; <ls>Ś. 5. 7</ls>. .²2 To put an end, to stop; वरेण शमितं लोकानलं दग्धुं हि तत्तपः <ls>Ku. 2. 56</ls>. .²3 To remove, avert; प्रतिकूलं दैवं शमयितुम् <ls>Ś. 1</ls>. .²4 To subdue, tame, defeat, conquer, vanquish; शमयति गजानन्यान् गन्धद्विपः कलभोऽपि सन् <ls>V. 5. 18</ls>; <ls>R. 9. 12</ls>, <ls n="R.">11. 59</ls>. .²5 To kill, destroy, slay; कर्णस्यात्मजमग्रतः शमयतः <ls>Ve. 5. 5</ls>. .²6 To quench, extinguish; शमितकुरुवंशप्रसविता <ls>Pt. 4. 50</ls>; सुतप्तमपि पानीयं शमयत्येव पावकम् <ls>H. 1. 85</ls>; <ls>Me. 55</ls>. .²7 To leave off, desist, cease. --II. €10 <ab>U.</ab> (शामयति-ते) .²1 To see, look at, inspect. .²2 To show, display.
